title: malus sylvestris
intro: Malus sylvestris, commonly known as wild apple or crab apple, is a deciduous shrub or small tree that belongs to the Rosaceae family. The health benefits of Malus sylvestris include its potential to lower cholesterol levels and aid in weight management due to its high fiber and antioxidant content. The therapeutic actions of this plant include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of Malus sylvestris include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
